system.description: Performance is for prancing dandies. Labor is for suckers and fools. Even fighting for your meal every day has a chance that you'll lose and go hungry. It's so much easier to just take what you want from the world, especially when you're so good at it. In any community with an underclass you're able to enjoy a moderate lifestyle by verging on violence to get your way, but ever passing the blame to the people who 'riled you' and owe you apologies and free service for their actions. You may have to deal with the occasional guard, but a quick smile and an arm around your victim, crushing their shoulder in mock friendliness, is often enough to avoid confrontation.
